children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Revanth Babu Raavi, Harsha Thota, Vamsi Rampalli
Sigmainfo: Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury, Divya Mishra, Magesh R
Agenda
Learn your feedback
What is the main benefit you receive so far?
Which functionality do you use the most?
What's your most frustrating experience so far?
What can we improve for you?
Discuss next steps
Key Takeaways

Mobile performance improvements are being pursued iteratively with core web vital changes that have already boosted the mobile score from around 59-60 to 70, noting that changes can take up to 28 days to reflect.

Enhanced tracking mechanisms for chat and log file data were discussed, including ensuring that chat traffic from platforms like ChatGPT is captured consistently across systems like Sigma and Cloudways.
A standardized lead tracking dashboard and template for lead-level data is to be finalized, ensuring all sources (organic, chat, ads) are clearly captured and monitored.
A structured SOP for using visitor behavior tools like Inspectlet, Microsoft Clarity, and Hotjar is to be developed to systematically review session recordings and derive actionable insights.

The SEO and content strategy will be refined by aligning topic suggestions with competitor insights and sales feedback, with an upcoming delivery of a topics list and clear guidance for external content partners.
Feature Mention
Iterative mobile core vitals improvements are in progress with changes reflected after 28 days; mobile score increased from around 59–60 to 70.
The development process is supported by AI tools integrated within the WordPress environment.
Chat workflow customization is planned to differentiate high-intent users coming from ChatGPT versus traditional organic sources.
A request was made to obtain specific access log details from the hosting environment to analyze user agents and crawling behavior.
Feedback
Feedback was provided on the need to track chat traffic sources and adjust the chatbot workflow based on the visitor's source.
Agreement to finalize a lead tracking template with detailed lead-level data (source, lead ID, landing page) was requested for timely insights.
There is a call to develop and use a checklist for newly created pages to ensure all required SEO elements are in place before launch.
The team was asked to develop a process for content recommendations, aligning blog topics with competitor insights and sales feedback.
Bug
Chat transcripts on the Sigma platform are not capturing source parameters (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT) as required.
Access log files provided from the hosting environment are limited due to restricted access; clarification is needed on obtaining full user agent data.
Positive Moment
Mobile performance improvements were highlighted with the mobile core vitals score rising to 70 following recent changes.
An increase in MQLs and overall lead conversion has been noted, reflecting positive impact from chatbot and SDR team coverage enhancements.
Pain Point
The high performance metrics in the web core vitals report indicate an urgent need for immediate fixes to avoid detrimental impacts.
A delay of up to 28 days for reflecting changes in Google PageSpeed insights hampers rapid mobile performance assessment.
Chat tracking on the Sigma platform is incomplete, leading to gaps in understanding visitor source and conversion data.
Incomplete access to log file details from the hosting environment restricts comprehensive crawling and user behavior analysis.
There is confusion among visitors as 31% of chat interactions mistakenly assume the firm offers loans, affecting lead quality.
There is a challenge in monitoring video sessions from tools like Clarity and Inspectlet, as it may not be feasible to view all recordings, and errors may be present in the videos.
The competitor produces less content than our team, which is evident from their website.
AI has been observed making significant errors, such as misclassifying valid links as spam, and should only be used as a guide.
A challenge with AI is the frequent introduction of new metrics, which can complicate tracking and analysis.
Action Item

Update the Lendfoundry lead tracker with the consolidated daily lead data as discussed.
Complete the messaging update for the homepage, loan servicing, and loan origination pages to clearly position Landfoundry as a software provider (not a loan provider) by this weekend.

Schedule a meeting with Divya and Shiresha to finalize the lead data tracking format and set a timeline for its enablement.
Work with the web team to develop and implement a checklist for new webpage creation that ensures all required SEO elements (e.g. proper meta titles, headers, user agent tracking) are included.

Harsha Thota will add the discussed keywords related to invoice financing, legal financing, and product development into the tracker and create a process for the sales and presales teams to share new keywords they encounter.
Discuss internally and finalize a list of content topics and keyword targets for Landfoundry, then share the list with Sandeep and the team.
Will work on an initial list of topics and share it while collecting additional feedback and data from the product and sales teams to establish a feedback loop.
Develop a consolidated tracking table for key marketing, SEO, and lead metrics (e.g. cost per lead, mobile core vitals) in coordination with relevant team members.
Review the content gap analysis document to inform the next blog strategy and provide input for new content topics.
Generate an AI report for Sigma similar to the one produced for Lendfoundry and share it with the team.
Sandeep Phophaliya
But keep Sandeep on the invite, keep Sandeep on the invite, but we can continue to make progress in my absence
Magesh R
Clarify with Cloudways regarding access log requirements by confirming which specific data (including user agent and browser information) is needed for proper analysis of website crawling.
Revanth Babu Raavi
Update the lead summary tracker by adding potential lead details, including requirements and associated content strategy suggestions derived from the discussion.
Vamsi Rampalli
Continue monitoring top-performing keywords via Google Search Console and incorporate relevant keywords into upcoming blog content where applicable.
Divya Mishra

Draft and share a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for using session recording and analysis tools (such as Inspectlet, Microsoft Clarity, and Hotjar) to monitor website performance and conversion issues.
Follow up
Web Performance Targets
Target mobile core vitals are LCP 2.3s, FCP 2.1s, and TTFP 1.5s. Iterative changes are in place with a 28-day update window; mobile score improved from ~59/60 to 70.
Content Gap Analysis
Content gap analysis for HCS, Fintech, Turnkey, and Loanpro revealed a massive gap. Actionable insights and low hanging fruit inputs are requested from Harsha.
Traffic Sources Analysis
Traffic data indicates mixed channels including organic, chat, and Google Ads. A proposal was made to add an overall traffic column to track unplanned sources like ChatGPT.
Chatbot Improvement Strategy
Strategies include tracking the origin of chatbot visitors (e.g., ChatGPT) to customize workflows, and expanding coverage with Australian (Yatin) and US (Matt) teams for high-intent lead follow-up.
Conversion Rate Optimization
A standardized lead tracking template is to be finalized, capturing lead ID, source, and landing page, with updates occurring within hours and consolidated weekly.
